devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
Real time can never be redeemed once lost. We cannot produce more time, but we can use every moment wisely. The Bible repeatedly warns us to use time carefully, because every second is an opportunity given by God. God Himself is a God of perfect timing, He sent Jesus to the world at the perfect time, delivered Israel at the perfect time, and will return again at the perfect time known only to Him. Therefore, we must be vigilant and act without delay.
Wasted time is not just lost minutes, it is lost ministry, lost souls, and lost blessings. God will ask how we used the time He entrusted to us, just like the servants with the talents. Delayed obedience is disobedience. Today’s opportunities will not always remain open; God gives seasons for prayer, evangelism, forgiveness, and service.
We speak often about the end times, but God expects an end-time lifestyle: watchful, prayerful, and compassionate for perishing souls. Every person we meet is on a countdown. This is why we must stand in the gap and act now. Time reveals our priorities—when we give God the first moments of our day, we declare that He is first in our hearts. Our Lord Jesus Himself lived with time discipline, completing His mission without wasting a moment. Let us imitate His urgency, not out of fear, but out of love.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: “Lost time is never found again.” - A.W. Tozer

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, teach us to number our days and use our time wisely. Help us act without delay in prayer, ministry, and compassion. Make us faithful stewards of every moment You give us. Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: May God fill your moments with purpose and your days with divine opportunities. Be watchful, be wise, for His perfect timing is at work in you.
